setup.help: Connect a Help Scout user account through OAuth2.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the OAuth access token with GET /users and return the first page metadata.

inboxes.list.title: List Inboxes
inboxes.list.description: List accessible Help Scout mailboxes with explicit 1-based pagination.

users.list.title: List Users
users.list.description: List Help Scout users with explicit 1-based pagination.

tags.list.title: List Tags
tags.list.description: List Help Scout tags with explicit 1-based pagination.

conversations.list.title: List Conversations
conversations.list.description: List Help Scout conversations. Conversations use the documented 25 item page size.

conversations.get.title: Get Conversation
conversations.get.description: Get one Help Scout conversation by numeric ID.

threads.list.title: List Threads
threads.list.description: List threads for a Help Scout conversation with explicit pagination.

mailboxes.list.title: List Mailboxes
mailboxes.list.description: List Help Scout mailboxes with explicit 1-based pagination.

mailboxes.description: Mailboxes.

mailboxes.get.title: Get Mailbox
mailboxes.get.description: Get one Help Scout mailbox by numeric ID.

users.me.title: Get Current User
users.me.description: Get the Help Scout user that owns the OAuth token (GET /users/me).

users.get.title: Get User
users.get.description: Get a Help Scout user by numeric ID.

customers.list.title: List Customers
customers.list.description: List Help Scout customers with optional mailbox and query filters.

customers.get.title: Get Customer
customers.get.description: Get one Help Scout customer by numeric ID.

customers.create.title: Create Customer
customers.create.description: Create a Help Scout customer. Returns the new ID in the Resource-ID header.

email.description: Work email stored as the first emails[] entry.

customers.update.title: Update Customer
customers.update.description: Replace a Help Scout customer with PUT /customers/{id}. Omitted fields are cleared.

conversations.create.title: Create Conversation
conversations.create.description: Create a Help Scout conversation in a mailbox with at least one thread.

customerEmail.description: Customer email. Creates the customer when no ID is given.

customerFirstName.description: Customer first name when creating by email.

customerLastName.description: Customer last name when creating by email.

assignTo.description: User or team ID to assign.

tags.description: Conversation tags.

conversations.update.title: Update Conversation
conversations.update.description: Patch a Help Scout conversation with one JSON Patch operation (subject, status, assignTo, mailboxId, or primary customer).

value.description: Patch value. String for subject/status, number for assignTo and mailboxId.

threads.create.title: Create Reply Thread
threads.create.description: Add a published or draft reply thread on a Help Scout conversation.

draft.description: True to create a draft reply.

status.description: Optional conversation status after the reply.

userId.description: User adding the thread. Defaults to the token owner.

assignTo.description: User or team assigned after publish.

threads.notes.create.title: Create Note Thread
threads.notes.create.description: Add an internal note thread on a Help Scout conversation.

userId.description: User adding the note. Defaults to the token owner.

status.description: Optional conversation status after the note.

customers.chats.create.title: Create Chat Handle
customers.chats.create.description: Tool to create a chat handle for a Help Scout customer. Use when you need to add a chat platform username (like Skype, AIM, Yahoo) to a customer's profile.

value.description: The chat handle/username on the specified platform

customerId.description: The customer ID for whom to create the chat handle

customers.chats.update.title: Update Chat Handle
customers.chats.update.description: Tool to update a chat handle for a Help Scout customer. Use when you need to modify an existing chat platform username (like Skype, AIM, Yahoo) associated with a customer's profile.

value.description: The updated chat handle/username on the specified platform

customerId.description: The customer ID whose chat handle to update

chatHandleId.description: The chat handle ID to update

customers.chats.delete.title: Delete Chat Handle
customers.chats.delete.description: Tool to delete a chat handle for a customer. Use when you need to remove a chat handle associated with a customer account.

chat_id.description: The unique identifier for the chat handle to be deleted

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer

customers.chats.list.title: List Chat Handles
customers.chats.list.description: Tool to list all chat handles for a specific customer in Help Scout. Use when you need to retrieve chat service accounts (Skype, AIM, ICQ, etc.) associated with a customer.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier for the customer whose chat handles to retrieve

customers.emails.create.title: Create customer email
customers.emails.create.description: Tool to create an email for a customer in Help Scout. Use when you need to add a new email address to a customer's profile.

value.description: Email address to add for the customer

customer_id.description: Identifier of the customer to add the email to

customers.emails.update.title: Update customer email
customers.emails.update.description: Tool to update an existing email for a customer in Help Scout. Use when you need to modify a customer's email address or change its type (home/work/other).

value.description: Updated email address for the customer

entry_id.description: Identifier of the email entry to update

customer_id.description: Identifier of the customer whose email to update

customers.emails.delete.title: Delete Customer Email
customers.emails.delete.description: Tool to delete an email for a customer. Use when you need to remove a customer's email address from Help Scout.

customers.emails.list.title: List Customer Emails
customers.emails.list.description: Tool to list all emails for a specific customer in Help Scout. Use when you need to retrieve all email addresses associated with a customer profile.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier for the customer whose emails to retrieve

customers.phones.create.title: Create Customer Phone
customers.phones.create.description: Tool to create a phone number for a Help Scout customer. Use when adding contact phone numbers to customer profiles.

customer_id.description: The customer ID to add the phone number to

customers.phones.update.title: Update Customer Phone
customers.phones.update.description: Tool to update an existing phone number for a Help Scout customer. Use when modifying phone number details or type for a customer's profile.

phone_id.description: The unique identifier for the phone number to update

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer whose phone should be updated

customers.phones.delete.title: Delete Customer Phone
customers.phones.delete.description: Tool to delete a customer's phone number from Help Scout. Use when you need to remove a phone number associated with a specific customer account.

phone_id.description: The unique identifier for the phone number to delete

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer whose phone should be removed

customers.phones.list.title: List Customer Phones
customers.phones.list.description: Tool to list all phone numbers for a specific Help Scout customer. Use when you need to retrieve the phone contact information for a customer.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer whose phones to retrieve

customers.websites.create.title: Create Customer Website
customers.websites.create.description: Tool to create a website entry for a customer in Help Scout. Use when adding a website URL to an existing customer profile.

value.description: The website URL to add to the customer profile

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to add the website to

customers.websites.update.title: Update Customer Website
customers.websites.update.description: Tool to update an existing website URL for a customer in Help Scout. Use when modifying a website entry on a customer's profile.

website_id.description: The ID of the website entry to update

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer whose website to update

customers.websites.delete.title: Delete Customer Website
customers.websites.delete.description: Tool to delete a website for a customer. Use when you need to remove a website from a customer record.

website_id.description: The unique identifier for the website to be deleted

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer

customers.websites.list.title: List Customer Websites
customers.websites.list.description: Tool to list all websites associated with a specific customer in Help Scout. Use when you need to retrieve all website URLs linked to a customer profile.

customer_id.description: Unique customer identifier to retrieve websites for

customers.socialProfiles.create.title: Create Social Profile
customers.socialProfiles.create.description: Tool to create a social profile for a customer in Help Scout. Use when you need to add social media profile information (LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook, etc.) to a customer record.

value.description: The social profile URL or handle. For URLs, provide the full URL (e.g., 'https://linkedin.com/in/testuser123'). For handles, provide the username.

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the customer to add the social profile to.

customers.socialProfiles.update.title: Update Customer Social Profile
customers.socialProfiles.update.description: Tool to update an existing social profile for a customer in Help Scout. Use when you need to modify a customer's social media profile URL or handle, or change its type.

value.description: The social profile URL or handle. For URLs, provide the full URL (e.g., 'https://twitter.com/testuser'). For handles, provide the username.

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the customer who owns the social profile.

socialProfileId.description: The unique identifier of the social profile to update.

customers.socialProfiles.delete.title: Delete Social Profile
customers.socialProfiles.delete.description: Tool to delete a social profile for a customer in Help Scout. Use when you need to remove a social media profile link from a customer record.

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the customer who owns the social profile.

socialProfileId.description: The unique identifier of the social profile to delete.

customers.socialProfiles.list.title: List Social Profiles
customers.socialProfiles.list.description: Tool to list all social profiles for a customer in Help Scout. Use when you need to retrieve a customer's social media profile information (LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook, etc.).

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the customer whose social profiles to retrieve.

customers.address.create.title: Create Customer Address
customers.address.create.description: Tool to create an address for a Help Scout customer. Use when you need to add a physical address to a customer's profile.

lines.description: Address lines (street address, building number, etc.).

state.description: State or province of the address.

country.description: Country code of the address (typically 2-letter ISO code).

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer.

postal_code.description: Postal code or ZIP code of the address.

customers.address.update.title: Update Customer Address
customers.address.update.description: Tool to update an existing address for a Help Scout customer. Use when you need to modify a customer's physical address.

lines.description: Address lines (street address, building number, etc.).

state.description: State or province of the address.

country.description: Country code of the address (typically 2-letter ISO code).

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer.

postal_code.description: Postal code or ZIP code of the address.

customers.address.delete.title: Delete Customer Address
customers.address.delete.description: Tool to delete a customer's address from Help Scout. Use when you need to remove address information associated with a specific customer account.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer whose address should be removed

customers.address.get.title: Get Customer Address
customers.address.get.description: Tool to retrieve a customer's address from Help Scout. Use when you need to fetch the physical address associated with a specific customer account.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer whose address should be retrieved.

customers.delete.title: Delete customer
customers.delete.description: Tool to permanently delete a customer by ID from Help Scout. This hard-deletes the customer including microsurvey responses and conversations (irreversible, GDPR compliant). Returns 403 if user lacks access to all conversations or customer has >100 conversations.

customer_id.description: The customer identifier to delete. This will permanently delete the customer including microsurvey responses and conversations.

customers.overwrite.title: Overwrite Customer
customers.overwrite.description: Tool to overwrite an existing customer in Help Scout, replacing all customer data. Use when you need to completely replace a customer's profile information. Fields not provided in the request will be set to null, effectively removing them.

age.description: Age or age range descriptor. If not provided, will be set to null.

phone.description: Phone number for the customer. Used when creating new customer.

jobTitle.description: Job title (max 60 characters). If not provided, will be set to null.

lastName.description: Customer's last name (1-40 characters). If not provided, will be set to null.

location.description: Customer's location (max 60 characters). If not provided, will be set to null.

photoUrl.description: URL to profile photo (max 200 characters). If not provided, will be set to null.

firstName.description: Customer's first name (1-40 characters). If not provided, will be set to null.

background.description: Background information or notes from the user interface (max 200 characters). If not provided, will be set to null.

organization.description: Organization name (max 60 characters). DEPRECATED: use organizationId instead. If not provided, will be set to null.

organizationId.description: Organization ID reference. If not provided, will be set to null.

customers.properties.update.title: Update Customer Properties
customers.properties.update.description: Tool to update custom property values for a Help Scout customer using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to modify existing property values like subscription plan, tier level, or custom attributes. Properties must be created first before updating values.

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the customer whose properties to update

operations.description: Array of JSON Patch operations to apply to the customer's properties. Each operation modifies a single property. Properties must be created first via the Create Property endpoint or web UI

customerProperties.create.title: Create Customer Property
customerProperties.create.description: Tool to create a customer property definition in Help Scout. Use when you need to add custom fields to track additional customer information like subscription plan, tier level, or custom attributes. Maximum 50 customer property definitions per company.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the property

slug.description: Unique identifier for the property (1-100 characters, alphanumeric with hyphens/underscores only). Cannot be 'email', 'name', 'company', or 'jobTitle' as these are reserved

options.description: List of dropdown options (max 100). Required when type is 'dropdown', ignored for other types. Each option must have a unique label

customerProperties.delete.title: Delete Customer Property
customerProperties.delete.description: Tool to perform a soft delete on a customer property definition. The property is scheduled for permanent deletion, with its slug temporarily reassigned during the grace period.

slug.description: The unique identifier (slug) for the customer property to delete

customerProperties.list.title: List Customer Properties
customerProperties.list.description: Tool to list all customer property definitions. Use when you need to view all custom properties configured for customers in the Help Scout account.

conversations.threads.chat.create.title: Create Chat Thread
conversations.threads.chat.create.description: Tool to create a new chat thread on a Help Scout conversation. Use when adding a chat message to an existing conversation. Note: Conversations can have a maximum of 100 threads. Non-imported threads automatically reopen closed conversations.

customer.description: Customer details. Either customer.id or customer.email must be provided.

imported.description: Set to true when importing historical data. Prevents notifications from being sent. Use for bulk imports or historical data migration.

createdAt.description: Custom creation timestamp for imported threads. ISO 8601 format. Only used when imported=true.

attachments.description: List of file attachments to include with the chat thread.

conversationId.description: The ID of the conversation to create the chat thread on.

conversations.threads.customer.create.title: Create Customer Thread
conversations.threads.customer.create.description: Tool to create a new customer thread on a Help Scout conversation. Use when a customer needs to add a message to an existing conversation. The conversation will reopen unless imported mode is enabled. Conversations are limited to 100 threads maximum.

cc.description: List of email addresses to CC on the thread

bcc.description: List of email addresses to BCC on the thread

text.description: The message text content for the thread

customer.description: Customer object. Must include either id or email field

imported.description: Enables historical import mode. When true, no notifications are generated and the conversation remains in its current state

createdAt.description: Custom creation date for imports (ISO 8601 format). Only used when imported is true

attachments.description: Optional list of attachments to include with the thread

conversationId.description: The ID of the conversation to add the thread to

conversations.threads.phone.create.title: Create Phone Thread
conversations.threads.phone.create.description: Tool to create a new phone thread on a Help Scout conversation. Use when you need to log a phone call interaction with a customer on an existing conversation.

text.description: The phone conversation text describing the call details

customer.description: Customer object with ID or email (at least one required)

imported.description: Set to true to create a historical thread without sending notifications or reopening the conversation

createdAt.description: Optional creation date in ISO 8601 format. Requires imported to be true

attachments.description: List of file attachments to include with the phone thread

conversationId.description: The ID of the conversation to add the phone thread to

conversations.threads.update.title: Update Thread
conversations.threads.update.description: Tool to update a specific thread in a Help Scout conversation using JSON Patch format. Use when you need to modify thread text content or hide/unhide a thread. Requires admin-level access or thread editing enabled for the account.

op.description: JSON Patch operation type. Only 'replace' is supported for thread updates

value.description: New value for the field. Use string for /text path (thread content), boolean for /hidden path (true to hide, false to unhide). Note: Original text is saved and viewable on Help Scout website

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread to update

conversationId.description: The unique identifier of the conversation containing the thread

conversations.threads.schedule.update.title: Update Conversation Thread Schedule
conversations.threads.schedule.update.description: Tool to update an existing schedule for a conversation thread in Help Scout. Use when you need to change when a reply or forward thread should be sent. Subsequent requests override previous schedules for the same thread.

thread_id.description: Identifier for the thread to schedule

scheduledFor.description: ISO 8601 date string in the future when the thread should be sent. Must not be after year 2100.

sendAsCreator.description: Whether the reply should be sent as the draft's original creator. Defaults to false.

conversation_id.description: Identifier for the conversation containing the thread

unscheduleOnCustomerReply.description: Determines if a new customer reply should unschedule the thread

conversations.threads.schedule.publish.title: Publish Thread Schedule
conversations.threads.schedule.publish.description: Tool to publish a scheduled thread immediately in a Help Scout conversation. Use when you need to send a scheduled message sooner than originally planned. The draft thread is turned into a reply/forward thread and the message is sent to the customer immediately.

thread_id.description: The unique identifier of the scheduled thread to publish immediately

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation containing the scheduled thread

conversations.threads.schedule.delete.title: Delete Thread Schedule
conversations.threads.schedule.delete.description: Tool to unschedule a scheduled thread in a conversation. Use when you need to convert a scheduled thread to a draft thread. The scheduled thread will be converted to a standard draft thread.

thread_id.description: The unique identifier of the thread to unschedule

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation containing the thread

conversations.delete.title: Delete Conversation
conversations.delete.description: Tool to move a conversation to the deleted folder. Use when you need to delete a conversation. The conversation can only be restored by a Help Scout administrator.

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation to delete

conversations.tags.update.title: Update Conversation Tags
conversations.tags.update.description: Tool to update tags on a conversation in Help Scout. Use when you need to add, remove, or replace tags on a conversation. This operation replaces the entire tag set - any existing tags not included will be removed.

tags.description: Complete list of tag names to apply to the conversation. This replaces all existing tags - tags not in this list will be removed. Non-existent tags are created automatically. To remove all tags, pass an empty array

conversations.fields.update.title: Update Custom Fields
conversations.fields.update.description: Tool to update custom fields on a Help Scout conversation. The complete fields list replaces existing data—omitted fields are removed. Use when you need to set or clear custom field values on a conversation.

fields.description: List of custom fields to be applied to the conversation. Complete list replaces existing data—omitted fields are removed. Empty array clears all custom fields.

conversations.snooze.update.title: Update Conversation Snooze
conversations.snooze.update.description: Tool to update or set a snooze on a Help Scout conversation. Use when you need to snooze a conversation until a specific date/time, optionally unsnoozing when the customer replies.

snoozed_until.description: ISO 8601 date string in the future when the conversation should be unsnoozed. Must not be after year 2100.

conversation_id.description: Unique identifier for the conversation to snooze

unsnooze_on_customer_reply.description: Whether a new customer response should automatically unsnooze the conversation

conversations.snooze.delete.title: Delete Snooze
conversations.snooze.delete.description: Tool to delete a snooze on a conversation. Use when you need to remove a snooze from a conversation, which will place it into its new home folder (Mine, Team or Unassigned, based on assignee).

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation to remove the snooze from

conversations.attachments.data.title: Get Attachment Data
conversations.attachments.data.description: Tool to retrieve attachment data for a specific attachment. Returns base64-encoded attachment content.

attachment_id.description: The unique identifier of the attachment to retrieve

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation containing the attachment

conversations.attachments.download.title: Download Attachment
conversations.attachments.download.description: Tool to download an attachment file from a Help Scout conversation. Use when you need to retrieve the actual file content of an attachment.

attachment_id.description: The unique identifier of the attachment file to download

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation containing the attachment

mailboxes.folders.list.title: List Inbox Folders
mailboxes.folders.list.description: Tool to retrieve all folders within a specific inbox/mailbox. Use when you need to list folders for organizing conversations or access folder details like ticket counts.

mailbox_id.description: Unique identifier for the mailbox to retrieve folders from

mailboxes.fields.list.title: List Inbox Custom Fields
mailboxes.fields.list.description: Tool to list all custom fields configured for a specific inbox. Use when you need to retrieve custom field definitions including field types, options, and display order.

mailbox_id.description: Unique identifier for the mailbox to retrieve custom fields from

mailboxes.routing.get.title: Get Routing Configuration
mailboxes.routing.get.description: Tool to retrieve routing configuration for a mailbox inbox. Use when you need to check assignment settings, rotation status, or user eligibility for receiving conversations.

mailbox_id.description: Unique identifier for the mailbox to retrieve routing configuration

mailboxes.routing.update.title: Update Mailbox Routing Configuration
mailboxes.routing.update.description: Tool to update routing configuration for a mailbox inbox in Help Scout. Use when you need to enable/disable routing, change assignment limits, modify assignment strategy, or update the list of users in rotation.

userIds.description: List of user IDs to include in the rotation. Must not be empty when routing state is 'enabled'. Users must be active and have access to the mailbox.

mailboxId.description: Unique identifier for the mailbox to update routing configuration

assignmentLimit.description: Maximum number of conversations that can be assigned (range: 1-100)

mailboxes.savedReplies.list.title: List Saved Replies
mailboxes.savedReplies.list.description: Tool to list saved replies for a mailbox. Use when you need to retrieve all saved reply templates available in a specific mailbox.

mailbox_id.description: The mailbox identifier to list saved replies from.

includeChatReplies.description: Should all saved replies (also chat-only) be included in response? Defaults to false if not specified.

mailboxes.savedReplies.get.title: Get Saved Reply
mailboxes.savedReplies.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific saved reply from a mailbox. Use when you need to get details about a saved reply template including its text content for email and chat.

mailbox_id.description: The mailbox identifier containing the saved reply.

saved_reply_id.description: The unique identifier for the saved reply to retrieve.

mailboxes.savedReplies.create.title: Create saved reply
mailboxes.savedReplies.create.description: Tool to create a saved reply for a mailbox in Help Scout. Use when you need to create reusable message templates for email or chat responses.

name.description: The name of the saved reply. This is used to identify and search for the reply.

text.description:
The saved reply's text content for email messages. Supports HTML formatting with tags like
for line breaks.

chatText.description: The saved reply's text content for chat messages. Use plain text with newline characters (\n) for line breaks instead of HTML.

mailboxId.description: The mailbox ID where the saved reply will be created. This identifies which mailbox the saved reply belongs to.

mailboxes.savedReplies.update.title: Update saved reply
mailboxes.savedReplies.update.description: Tool to update an existing saved reply in a Help Scout mailbox. Use when you need to modify the name or content of a saved reply template.

name.description: The name of the saved reply. This is used to identify and search for the reply.

text.description:
The saved reply's text content for email messages. Supports HTML formatting with tags like
for line breaks.

chatText.description: The saved reply's text content for chat messages. Use plain text with newline characters (\n) for line breaks instead of HTML.

mailboxId.description: The mailbox ID where the saved reply exists. This identifies which mailbox the saved reply belongs to.

savedReplyId.description: The unique identifier of the saved reply to update.

mailboxes.savedReplies.delete.title: Delete Saved Reply
mailboxes.savedReplies.delete.description: Tool to delete a saved reply from a mailbox. Use when you need to permanently remove a saved reply. Returns 204 No Content on successful deletion.

mailboxId.description: The unique identifier for the mailbox containing the saved reply to delete.

savedReplyId.description: The unique identifier for the saved reply to delete.

tags.get.title: Get Tag
tags.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific tag by ID from Help Scout. Use when you need to get details about a tag including its name, slug, and color.

tag_id.description: The unique identifier for the tag to retrieve.

teams.list.title: List Teams
teams.list.description: Tool to list all teams in Help Scout with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve a list of all available teams.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

users.status.get.title: Get User Status
users.status.get.description: Tool to get the status of a user in Help Scout. Use when you need to check a user's email availability (active/away) or chat status across mailboxes.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose status to retrieve

users.status.set.title: Set User Status
users.status.set.description: Tool to set the status of a user in Help Scout. Use when you need to change a user's availability to 'active' or 'away'. Administrators and Account Owners can edit other users' status.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose status to update

users.status.list.title: List Users Status
users.status.list.description: Tool to list the status of all users including email and chat availability. Use when you need to check which users are currently active, away, or available for different channels.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

workflows.list.title: List Workflows
workflows.list.description: Tool to list all workflows (automation rules) in the account with optional filters for mailbox, type, and status. Use when you need to retrieve workflows to view automation rules configured in Help Scout.

workflows.run.title: Run Manual Workflow
workflows.run.description: Tool to run a manual workflow on one or more conversations in Help Scout. Use when you need to execute workflow actions on specific conversations. Only manual workflows can be executed via this action, and all conversation IDs must be from the same inbox as the workflow.

workflowId.description: The identifier of the manual workflow to execute

conversationIds.description: An array of conversation IDs to apply the workflow to. The workflow actions will be applied to each conversation. Maximum of 50 IDs per request. All conversation IDs must belong to existing conversations and be from the same inbox as the workflow.

workflows.status.update.title: Update Workflow Status
workflows.status.update.description: Tool to update the status of a Help Scout workflow (enable/disable automation rule). Use when you need to activate or deactivate a workflow.

workflow_id.description: The unique identifier of the workflow to update

webhooks.list.title: List Webhooks
webhooks.list.description: Tool to retrieve all webhooks configured in Help Scout. Use when you need to view all webhook subscriptions and their configurations.

webhooks.get.title: Get Webhook
webhooks.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific webhook by ID from Help Scout. Use when you need to view webhook configuration details including URL, events, state, and other settings.

webhook_id.description: The unique identifier of the webhook to retrieve

webhooks.create.title: Create Webhook
webhooks.create.description: Tool to create a new webhook subscription in Help Scout to receive real-time event notifications. Use when setting up webhook integrations to track conversations, customers, tags, or other events.

url.description: The callback URL where webhook events will be sent

events.description: Array of event names to subscribe to for webhook notifications

secret.description: Secret key for webhook signature verification (max 40 characters)

mailboxIds.description: Array of mailbox IDs to scope webhook to specific mailboxes. If omitted, webhook applies to all mailboxes

notification.description: If true, sends only resource URI instead of full payload

webhooks.update.title: Update Webhook
webhooks.update.description: Tool to update an existing webhook subscription in Help Scout. Use when modifying webhook configuration such as URL, events, secret, or other settings.

url.description: The callback URL where webhook events will be sent

events.description: Array of event names to subscribe to for webhook notifications

secret.description: Secret key for webhook signature verification (max 40 characters)

mailboxIds.description: Array of mailbox IDs to scope webhook to specific mailboxes. If omitted, webhook applies to all mailboxes

webhook_id.description: The unique identifier of the webhook to update

notification.description: If true, sends only resource URI instead of full payload

webhooks.delete.title: Delete Webhook
webhooks.delete.description: Tool to permanently delete a webhook subscription from Help Scout. Use when you need to remove webhook integrations that are no longer needed.

webhook_id.description: The unique identifier of the webhook to delete

organizations.list.title: List Organizations
organizations.list.description: Tool to list all organizations (companies) in Help Scout with optional filtering and sorting. Use when you need to retrieve a list of organizations, search for specific organizations by name, or get paginated organization results.

name.description: Filter organizations by name. Performs a partial match search.

page.description: Page number for pagination (starts at 1). Default is 1.

organizations.create.title: Create Organization
organizations.create.description: Tool to create a new organization in Help Scout. Use when you need to create a company profile with associated domains, contact information, and metadata.

note.description: Internal notes about the organization (visible only to team members)

phones.description: Array of phone numbers associated with the organization

domains.description: Array of domain strings associated with the organization

organizations.get.title: Get Organization
organizations.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific organization by ID from Help Scout. Use when you need to fetch details about an organization including name, website, domains, and contact information.

includeCounts.description: Whether to include customer and conversation counts in the response.

organization_id.description: The unique identifier for the organization to retrieve.

includeProperties.description: Whether to include organization property values in the response.

organizations.update.title: Update Organization
organizations.update.description: Tool to update an organization in Help Scout. Use when you need to modify organization details such as name, website, domains, or contact information. This is a complete update operation - provide all fields to avoid removal of existing data.

name.description: Organization name (required). This is a complete update - all required fields must be provided.

note.description: Internal notes about the organization (visible only to team members). Omitting this will clear the note.

phones.description: Array of phone numbers associated with the organization (required). Provide empty array if no phones.

domains.description: Array of domain strings associated with the organization (required). Provide empty array if no domains.

website.description: Organization website URL (required). This is a complete update - all required fields must be provided.

location.description: Physical location of the organization. Omitting this will clear the location.

brandColor.description: Brand color in hex format (e.g., #fefefe). Omitting this will clear the brand color.

description.description: Description of the organization. Omitting this will clear the description.

organization_id.description: The unique identifier for the organization to update.

organizations.delete.title: Delete Organization
organizations.delete.description: Tool to delete an organization by ID. Use when removing an organization from Help Scout. This operation also removes the reference to this organization from all associated customers.

organization_id.description: The organization's unique identifier to delete

organizations.conversations.list.title: Get Organization Conversations
organizations.conversations.list.description: Tool to get conversations associated with an organization in Help Scout. Use when you need to retrieve all conversations linked to a specific organization. Returns paginated results with HAL+JSON format.

organizationId.description: The organization ID for retrieving associated conversations

organizations.customers.list.title: Get Organization Customers
organizations.customers.list.description: Tool to get customers associated with an organization in Help Scout. Use when you need to retrieve a list of all customers belonging to a specific organization. Returns paginated results with 50 customers per page.

organizationProperties.list.title: List Organizations Properties
organizationProperties.list.description: Tool to list all organization property definitions. Use when you need to view all custom properties configured for organizations in the Help Scout account.

organizationProperties.create.title: Create Organization Property
organizationProperties.create.description: Tool to create a new custom property definition for organizations in Help Scout. Use when you need to add custom fields to track organization-specific data like industry, account tier, renewal dates, or other metadata. Maximum 50 property definitions allowed per account.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the property shown in the UI; maximum 100 characters

slug.description: Unique logical identifier for the property within the account; must be 1-120 characters in length. Used as the property key in API calls.

options.description: Array of dropdown choices; required when type is 'dropdown', ignored otherwise. Maximum 100 options allowed per property.

organizationProperties.get.title: Get Organization Property
organizationProperties.get.description: Tool to retrieve a single organization property definition by its slug identifier. Use when you need to get details about a specific custom property configured for organizations, including its type, display name, and available options.

slug.description: Property definition's unique slug identifier. This is the key used to identify the property in the API.

organizationProperties.update.title: Update Organization Property
organizationProperties.update.description: Tool to update an organization property definition in Help Scout. Use when you need to modify the name or options of an existing custom property. Note: Property type and slug cannot be changed after creation.

name.description: Updated name of the property; maximum 100 characters

slug.description: The identifier for the organization property being updated. This is the property's unique slug.

options.description: The updated list of options for a dropdown property. Maximum 100 options. When provided, this completely replaces existing options. Note: Removing options will delete all property values for those options.

organizationProperties.industry.update.title: Update Organization Property Industry
organizationProperties.industry.update.description: Tool to update the industry organization property definition in Help Scout. Use when you need to modify the display name or available dropdown options for the industry field. Note: updating options replaces the entire list and removed options cascade delete existing values.

name.description: Updated display name for the industry property. Maximum 100 characters.

options.description: Updated list of industry options for the dropdown. Maximum 100 options. When provided, the entire options list is replaced - any removed options will cascade delete existing values.

organizationProperties.delete.title: Delete Organization Property Customer Tier
organizationProperties.delete.description: Tool to delete a customer tier property definition from organizations. This performs a soft-delete, and the property will be removed permanently after a grace period. Use when you need to remove a custom organization property definition.

slug.description: The property definition identifier slug. Use 'customer-tier' to delete the customer tier property.

organizations.properties.set.title: Set Organization Property Value
organizations.properties.set.description: Tool to set or update a property value for a specific organization. Use when you need to assign a value to a custom property field on an organization, such as setting their tier, industry, or other metadata.

slug.description: Property definition's unique slug identifier. This is the key used to identify the property in the API.

value.description: The property value formatted as a string. Format requirements vary by property type: text/URL (plain string), number ('100'), date ('2024-01-15' in ISO 8601 format), dropdown (option label). If a property already has a value, it will be replaced with this new value.

organization_id.description: Unique identifier of the organization to set the property value for

organizations.properties.remove.title: Remove Organization Property Value
organizations.properties.remove.description: Tool to remove an organization property value. Use when clearing the value of a custom property for a specific organization. The property definition itself is not deleted, only its value for this organization is cleared.

slug.description: Property definition's unique slug identifier. This is the key used to identify the property in the API.

reports.conversations.volumeByChannel.title: Get Volume by Channel Report
reports.conversations.volumeByChannel.description: Tool to retrieve conversation volume by channel (email, chat, phone) over a specified time period. Use when you need to analyze conversation volume trends across different communication channels. Requires Help Scout Plus or Pro plan.

end.description: End of the interval in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-31T23:59:59Z'). Required parameter for the report date range.

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tag IDs to filter results. Only includes conversations with specified tags.

start.description: Start of the interval in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Required parameter for the report date range.

types.description: Comma-separated list of conversation types to include. Valid values: email, chat, phone. If not specified, all types are included.

folders.description: Comma-separated list of folder IDs to filter results. Only includes conversations from specified folders.

mailboxes.description: Comma-separated list of mailbox IDs to filter results. Only includes conversations from specified mailboxes.

previousEnd.description: Ending date for comparison period in ISO 8601 format. When provided with previousStart, enables comparison with a previous time period.

previousStart.description: Beginning date for comparison period in ISO 8601 format. When provided with previousEnd, enables comparison with a previous time period.
